note: Source of truth for ad blocking. extension/rules/adblock.json and ios/Resources/blocker-rules.json are generated from this file by scripts/build-adblock.mjs — edit here, run `npm run sync:shared`. The backend serves it at /api/adblock so a list this old can be replaced without an extension or app-store release.

popunder.why: Opens tabs and redirects the reader mid-chapter. The single worst thing a scan site does, and the reason popup-guard.js exists as a second line.

banner.why: Serves the creatives themselves, so the image type is blocked too — otherwise the script is gone and the banner still loads.

programmatic.why: The exchanges the slots are auctioned through. Blocking the auction is what empties the slot; the creative never gets requested.

analytics.why: Measurement, not advertising, but it follows the reader from site to site. Images are blocked here precisely because the payload is often a 1x1 pixel. googletagmanager.com is listed alongside google-analytics.com because it is the loader: block only the collector and gtag.js still runs, builds the profile and keeps trying to send it.

video-ads.why: Pre-roll and in-player overlays on streaming sites. Blocked as requests rather than by hiding an element: an overlay hidden with CSS has still loaded, still counted, and still holds the click that opens a tab.
